## Engineering & Writing Philosophy

1. **Systems Built for Reliability & Longevity**
   Victor approaches software engineering through the dual lens of systems architecture and human comprehension. Software that functions but cannot be maintained or understood by a team incurs compounding technical debt.

2. **Clarity is an Engineering Multiplier**
   Documentation is not an afterthought; it is an architectural specification. Precision in technical writing forces clarity in software design.

3. **Disciplined Craft**
   Commit hygiene, idempotent API design, structured logging, and thorough testability are baseline non-negotiables for production systems.

## Core Technical Projects

### 1. techDNA (https://www.techdna.app)
- **Category**: Full-Stack AI Application & Career Discovery
- **Architecture**: Next.js 14, React, Tailwind CSS, Supabase PostgreSQL, Vercel AI SDK, Google Gemini API, Paystack.
- **Description**: A dual-stage career fit engine that combines a 10-question digital literacy assessment with a 40-question psychometric personality engine, matching users with technology careers tailored to their innate strengths.

### 2. Volta (https://volta-dun.vercel.app)
- **Category**: AI & Real-Time Token Streaming
- **Architecture**: FastAPI, Python 3.12, Vanilla JavaScript, Google Gemini API, Server-Sent Events (SSE), SQLite.
- **Description**: A dark-themed poetry generation engine that streams AI-crafted verse token-by-token with real-time semantic analysis, stanza revision, and shareable canvases.

### 3. Fathers (https://early-fathers.ai.studio/)
- **Category**: Contemplative Web Platform & Patristic Literature
- **Architecture**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Cormorant Garamond typography, Web Share API.
- **Description**: A quiet, reflective digital collection of words and wisdom from the Fathers of the Early Church (Augustine, John Chrysostom, Athanasius, Clement, Desert Fathers). Features random quotation discovery, favorites curation, and ambient theme switching.

### 4. Redocly Developer Documentation (https://demo-3d453564.mintlify.app/)
- **Category**: Docs-as-Code Portal
- **Architecture**: Mintlify, MDX, Markdown React, OpenAPI/Swagger.
- **Description**: Mintlify-hosted developer documentation portal for Redoc, generating clean, structured three-panel API documentation from OpenAPI specifications.

### 5. Anthropic Messages API Docs (https://creatorsgrowth.mintlify.app/home)
- **Category**: Developer Documentation & Tutorials
- **Architecture**: Mintlify, MDX, Claude API, Anthropic Messages API.
- **Description**: Comprehensive developer guide covering how to integrate Claude into production applications via the Anthropic Messages API.

### 6. Sage AI Assistant (https://sage-ai-docs.streamlit.app/)
- **Category**: RAG & Vector Search
- **Architecture**: Python, Streamlit, Google Gemini API, FAISS vector embeddings.
- **Description**: Document question-answering assistant allowing users to query manuscripts (PDF, TXT, DOCX) through semantic search and vector retrieval.

## Selected Publications

- **"Stop Writing 'Fix Stuff': A Better Way to Commit"** (https://medium.com/@victorzion1/stop-writing-fix-stuff-a-better-way-to-commit-36a2651aa2db)
  *Key thesis*: Disciplined Git commit hygiene transforms version control from a backup tool into an immutable architectural changelog.
- **"AI Engineering vs ML Engineering: Not the Same Job"** (https://medium.com/@victorzion1/ai-engineering-vs-ml-engineering-not-the-same-job-22a1c7e92619)
  *Key thesis*: Contrasts the daily workflows of model training/weights optimization (ML Engineering) with context window orchestration, evaluation loops, and system integration (AI Engineering).
- **"Idempotency: The Backend Concept That Saves You at 3 AM"** (https://medium.com/@victorzion1/idempotency-the-backend-concept-that-saves-you-at-3-am-66e01b00e99d)
  *Key thesis*: How to build distributed API endpoints and message queues that safely withstand duplicate retries, double billing, and network jitter.
